newsitem.title: USA: Colombia Cusiana crude demand in US to rise-Triton.
newsitem.headline: Colombia Cusiana crude demand in US to rise-Triton.

text.p: Crude oil from Colombia's Cusiana and Cupiagua fields is expected to rise to 20 percent of light, sweet crude imported into the U.S. east of the Rockies by the end of this year, Triton Energy Ltd said on Monday.
Triton said that the rise will occur as production from the two fields triples to 500,000 barrels per day by the end of the year.

Earlier, Triton confirmed that the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) has added Cusiana crude, a gasoline-rich crude, as a deliverable foreign crude for NYMEX's light, sweet crude oil-futures contract starting with the July contract.
Triton has a 12 percent stake in a consortium with British Petroleum Co Plc, Total SA and Colombia's Ecopetrol. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
